events.name: Madras Randonneurs BRM 300: The Village Link
events.registration_notes: Online registration closes 16 Oct 2026 at 13:00; limited spot registration.
events.summary: A 300 km brevet by Madras Randonneurs on coastal and village roads around Chennai, to be completed within 20 hours. The route is designed to avoid city traffic. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 300 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register

course.description: Starts in Velachery, takes OMR to villages around Chennai, connects to GST Road and returns via ECR, mixing state highway and village roads to avoid traffic. Start coordinates are approximate.

highlights: 300 km in 20 hours
OMR, GST Road and ECR coastal loop
Mostly flat coastal plain
tips: Registration closes the day before; spot entries are limited
Expect heat and humidity on ECR by midday; carry electrolytes
05:30 start: lights needed at the start and finish

events.name: Tri Goa Foundation BRM 200: A Taste of Goa
events.organiser: Tri Goa Foundation (Audax India Randonneurs, ACP-affiliated)
events.summary: A 200 km brevet looping through South Goa's interior and coast, including the Netravali Wildlife Sanctuary, to be completed within 13.5 hours. Hillier than most 200s with nearly 1800 m of climbing. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 200 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register
categories.notes: Fee includes AIR homologation, ride validation and a rider kit.

course.description: Panjim, Dona Paula, Old Goa, Margao, Sanguem, Rivona, Netravali, Cavorem, Cuncolim, Cavelossim, Colva and back to Panjim. 201.7 km and about 1774 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: Netravali Wildlife Sanctuary and South Goa beaches on one loop
Rider kit included
Nearly 1800 m of climbing
tips: Helmet, front and rear lights and a reflective vest are mandatory
Take selfies at unmanned control points as proof of passage
Mobile signal is patchy in Netravali; download the route offline

events.name: Pune Randonneurs Knight Riders 100 (BP)
events.summary: A 100 km Brevet Populaire run by Pune Randonneurs, the introductory distance in Audax randonneuring. It is a good first timed long ride before attempting a 200 km BRM. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 100 km BP
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register

course.description: Fitness Culture, Narhe, Chandni Chowk, Dehu Road to Tony Da Dhaba and back via Sun City to Sinhagad Road. 102.8 km and about 792 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: Entry-level 100 km Audax ride with a 7.5 h limit
Low fee of Rs 300
Run by Pune Randonneurs, the club that ran India's first overnight brevets
tips: 05:30 start: fit front and rear lights for the pre-dawn section
Chandni Chowk and Dehu Road carry heavy truck traffic; ride single file
Good stepping stone to a BRM 200 later in the season

events.name: Lakshya Randonneurs BRM 600: Mussoorie Masala
events.registration_notes: Closes 21 Oct 2026 at 20:00. Night start at 22:00.
events.summary: A mountainous 600 km brevet from Noida to Mussoorie and back with over 6000 m of climbing, to be completed within 40 hours. It starts at 22:00, so the first night is spent riding the plains towards Dehradun. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 600 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register
categories.notes: Fee includes an exclusive finisher medal; no other charges or GST.

course.description: Noida to the Mussoorie hills in the Garhwal Himalaya and back, starting at night. 601 km and about 6391 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: 600 km with about 6400 m of climbing
Climb to Mussoorie in the Himalayan foothills
Finisher medal included in the fee
tips: Night start at 22:00: sleep during the day before
Mussoorie can be cold at night in late October; pack a windproof layer
Use low gearing; the Mussoorie climb is long and steep

events.name: Mumbai Randonneurs BRM 200: Pali Parikrama
events.venue: Marathon Cosmos, LBS Road, Mulund West
events.registration_notes: Closes 19 Oct 2026 at 19:00. Fee paid to AIR via gateway; non-refundable and non-transferable.
events.summary: A 200 km Brevet de Randonneur Mondial run by Mumbai Randonneurs, India's first randonneuring club (first Indian brevet was held in Mumbai in 2010). The loop heads out of Mumbai to the Pali Ballaleshwar temple area and back. Finishing within 13.5 hours earns an ACP-homologated brevet. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 200 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register

course.description: Mulund to Khopoli, Pali and Karnala and back to Ghansoli, through the Sahyadri foothills of Raigad district. 200.8 km and about 1191 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: ACP-sanctioned 200 km brevet, 13.5 h limit
Pali, Khopoli and Karnala loop in the Sahyadri foothills
Organised by India's oldest randonneuring club
tips: Start from Mulund West at 06:00; exit Mumbai before highway traffic builds
Carry enough water for the Khopoli-Pali stretch and buy food at towns en route
Lights and reflective gear needed for any riding after dusk
amenities: Medal available on request after finishing

events.name: Secunderabad Randonneurs BRM 200: MEGA-200

events.summary: A 200 km BRM run by Secunderabad Randonneurs heading north from Secunderabad to Kamareddy and back. categories.name: 200 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register

course.description: Secunderabad (Gunrock area) to Kamareddy and back on the NH44 corridor. 211.7 km and about 1378 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: ACP-sanctioned 200 km brevet, 13.5 h limit
Mostly highway riding on the Deccan plateau
Same club runs 300 km (28 Oct) and 400 km (30 Oct) the same week
tips: Long highway stretches with little shade: carry two bottles and electrolytes
Mid-week date (Tuesday): plan leave in advance
Route is 211.7 km, not 200, so pace for the extra distance

events.name: Bangalore Randonneurs BRM 600: Benne Dose
events.venue: Sir M. Visvesvaraya Central College Metro Station area
events.summary: A 600 km brevet by Bangalore Randonneurs, one of India's largest randonneuring clubs. It must be finished within 40 hours and is part of a Super Randonneur series (200, 300, 400, 600). Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 600 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register

course.description: A 602 km loop from central Bengaluru named after the benne dose (butter dosa) of Davanagere. About 3650 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: 600 km in 40 hours
Counts towards the Super Randonneur series
Large club with regular rider turnout
tips: Plan a short sleep stop; most riders take 30-36 hours
Carry lights with spare batteries for two nights on the road
Start is in central Bengaluru near the KG Road metro

events.name: Cycle Network Grow BRM 200: NH2
events.organiser: Cycle Network Grow (Audax India Randonneurs, ACP-affiliated)
events.summary: A 200 km brevet run by Kolkata's Cycle Network Grow club on the flat NH2 corridor, to be completed within 13.5 hours. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 200 km BRM

events.name: Cyclone Cycling Club BRM 300: Baroda Trimandir
events.organiser: Cyclone Cycling Club (Audax India Randonneurs, ACP-affiliated)
events.registration_notes: Closes 30 Oct 2026 at 23:00. Early-bird price of Rs 1700 for the first 15 riders until 21 Oct.
events.summary: A 300 km brevet from Ahmedabad to Vadodara and back, to be completed within 20 hours. Flat terrain on paved highway and side roads. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 300 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register
categories.notes: Standard price; early-bird Rs 1700 for the first 15 registrations.

course.description: Ahmedabad to Vadodara along the Ahmedabad-Baroda highway and back, with tree-lined paved roads and farmland. 300 km and about 1155 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: 300 km in 20 hours
Flat Ahmedabad-Vadodara route
Season opener for Ahmedabad's club
tips: Book by 21 Oct for the early-bird price

06:00 start from Gotila Garden; plan for a night finish

events.name: Jaipur Cycling Comrades BRM 400: Chittorgarh
events.organiser: Jaipur Cycling Comrades (Audax India Randonneurs, ACP-affiliated)

categories.name: 400 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register
categories.notes: Standard price; early-bird Rs 1600 for the first 15 registrations.

events.name: Hyderabad Randonneurs Cities to Coast 1200 LRM
events.registration_notes: Registration closed on 2 Oct 2026. Fee is non-refundable and non-transferable; bike transport back is an optional paid service.
events.summary: A 1200 km Les Randonneurs Mondiaux (LRM) ride from Hyderabad to the Goa coast, to be completed within 90 hours. It crosses the Deccan plateau, the Western Ghats at Jog Falls and the Konkan coast. Unlike shorter brevets, the fee covers drop bags and rest points.

categories.name: 1200 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register
categories.notes: Fee includes drop bags and rest rooms at 394 km and 782 km, one night in Goa, food at drop-bag points, medal, event T-shirt and homologation.

course.description: Hyderabad via Shadnagar and NH44 to Kurnool and Anantapur, then into the Western Ghats via Chitradurga, Shivamogga and Jog Falls, down to Gokarna and Karwar on the Konkan coast and on to Goa. 1211.4 km and about 7188 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: 1200 km in 90 hours, about 7200 m of climbing
Deccan plateau to Western Ghats to Konkan coast
Drop bags and rest rooms at 394 km and 782 km
tips: Registration is already closed; use it as a target for the next season
Plan sleep at the 394 km and 782 km drop-bag points
Book the optional bike transport from Goa early

events.name: Bangalore Randonneurs BRM 300: Basavanbetta (SR5 series)

course.description: A 305 km loop from KG Road to the Basavanbetta hills south of Bengaluru and back, with about 2959 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: 300 km in 20 hours with nearly 3000 m of climbing
Part of a back-to-back SR series week
Starts from FKCCI, KG Road in central Bengaluru
tips: Hilly for a 300: use compact gearing and pace the climbs
07:00 start means finishing after dark; carry full night lighting
Register before 10 Nov; the club's events fill with large fields

events.name: Bangalore Randonneurs BRM 200: Village 200K

Club anniversary ride

events.name: Deccan Cliffhanger
events.venue: Keshavbaug, DP Road, Karve Nagar, Pune (start); Bogmallo Beach, Goa (finish)
events.registration_notes: No 2026 announcement found. Expected date follows the late-November start of the 2024 edition (30 Nov 2024); the 2025 edition date could not be verified.
events.summary: A non-stop supported ultra-cycling race of about 646 km from Pune to Goa through the Sahyadri ghats, with solo and relay team categories. It has served as a Race Across America qualifier for Indian riders. Riders need their own support crew vehicle.

categories.name: Solo
categories.notes: Time limit of 38 hours as reported for the 2024 edition; a 2017 report cited 33 hours for RAAM qualification.

categories.name: Relay team
categories.notes: Team sizes not published in sources found.

course.description: Point-to-point from Karve Nagar, Pune to Bogmallo Beach in South Goa, about 643-646 km depending on source, ridden through the night.

highlights: One of India's longest-running ultra-cycling races
Used by Indian riders as a Race Across America qualifier
Solo and relay categories
tips: Confirm the 2026 date directly with Inspire India before booking leave or crew
Plan night riding with lights and a follow vehicle; the route runs through the night
Build up with 400 and 600 km brevets before attempting solo

events.name: Lakshya Randonneurs BRM 400: The GT Road Saga
events.summary: A 400 km brevet along the historic Grand Trunk Road from Noida into Haryana, to be completed within 27 hours. Flat but long, with a night section on the return. Self-supported: no aid stations or sag wagon, riders carry or buy their own food and water between controls.

categories.name: 400 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register

course.description: Noida via Murthal, Panipat, Karnal and Kurukshetra to Shahbad on the Grand Trunk Road and back. 400.8 km and about 1410 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: 400 km in 27 hours on the GT Road (NH44)
Flat profile
Dhaba stops at Murthal on the route
tips: December nights in Haryana are cold and foggy: carry warm layers and strong lights
Expect heavy highway traffic; ride on the shoulder with a reflective vest
Murthal dhabas are a reliable food stop on both legs

events.name: Tour of Nilgiris
events.registration_notes: Registration is sold through the TFN online store with room-sharing options (triple, double, single). Pre-tour briefing in Mysuru on 5 Dec 2026.
events.summary: A fully supported 7-day touring ride of about 700 km from Mysuru through Coorg and Wayanad to Ooty, run for 16 editions. Riders stay in resorts each night and get support stations, a sag wagon, mechanics, doctors and physios every day. It is one of India's best known multi-day cycling tours and is non-competitive.

categories.name: Full TFN (7 riding days)
categories.notes: 694 km is the sum of the published daily stages. Store price shown; it varies with room-sharing option. Includes 8 nights stay, meals and full support.

categories.name: Half TFN
categories.notes: First-half or second-half option per the store listing; exact half distances not published.

course.description: Stages: Mysuru to Madikeri 153 km (+2302 m), Madikeri to Sultan Bathery 153 km, Sultan Bathery to Ooty 108 km (+2821 m), rest day, Ooty-Kinnakorai loop 111 km (+2843 m), Ooty-Kodanad loop 102 km (+2572 m), Ooty-Pillur Dam loop 67 km (+1597 m). Elevation total is summed from the official stage figures.

highlights: About 694 km and roughly 14,500 m of climbing over 6 riding days plus a rest day in Ooty
Crosses Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu
3-5 support stations a day, sweep truck, ambulance, doctor and physio on route
Any human-powered cycle allowed; road and gravel bikes available to rent
tips: Reach Mysuru for the 5 Dec briefing; FlyBus from Bengaluru airport or fly to Mysuru airport (about 10 km from the start)
Riding after sundown is not allowed and each support station has a cut-off, so practise back-to-back 100-150 km hilly days
Mechanics do not fix flats mid-ride; carry tubes and know how to change one
Plan your exit from Ooty: Coimbatore airport is 130-140 km away and return transport is not included

events.name: Lakshya Randonneurs BRM 200: Gajraula

categories.name: 200 km BRM
categories.eligibility: AIR rider account (subscriber login) needed to register

course.description: Noida to Hapur, Garhmukteshwar and Gajraula and back on the same road. 203.7 km and about 768 m of climbing per the official route map.

highlights: Flat 200 km with under 800 m of climbing
Crosses the Ganga at Garhmukteshwar
Finisher medal included
tips: Mid-December mornings are foggy: use a bright front light and reflective vest at the 06:00 start
